_comment: Pixel coordinates of HUD elements on YOUR screen, at YOUR game resolution and HUD scale. Use vision/calibrate.py to find these values, then fill them in here. Leave a region null until it's calibrated - the code treats null as 'not yet set up' and skips it rather than reading the wrong part of the screen. team_stamina_bars is a LIST since a squad has up to 11 players - add one entry per stamina bar you can see (e.g. on the team management / player instructions screen), and the average is used for team_stamina_avg_pct.
